description: One perpetual futures market on Sui (Aftermath, Bluefin or Parchment): mark and index price, 24h change and volume, open interest, funding (last, estimated next, when), max leverage, fees, the latest trades and pools it backs. venue.description: aftermath, bluefin or parchment. Leave it out for the busiest.
